name: ANTA Sports Products Limited
summary: ANTA Sports Products Limited engages in the research, design, development, manufacture, market, and sale of professional sports footwear, apparel, and accessories in China and internationally. The company's products portfolio includes running, cross-training, basketball, professional competition, training, physical education classes, outdoor sports, triathlon, golf, skiing, camping, hiking, urban outdoor, tennis, and other sports under the FILA, FILA KIDS, FILA FUSION, AMER, KOLON SPORT, JACK WOLFSKIN, ANTA, DESCENTE, and ANTA KIDS brands, as well as sports fabrics under MAIA ACTIVE brand name.
